data.gender_notes: Nahyla is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nahyla symbolizes the gentle and serene first light of dawn, signifying a new beginning and hope. In Islamic tradition, it represents a fresh start and a chance to make a positive impact. The name Nahyla carries the meaning “First Light of Dawn” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nahyla usually hope their child will grow to embody first light of dawn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nahyla is reminiscent of the Quranic concept of 'Fajr' (dawn), symbolizing the triumph of good over evil.
data.etymology: Nahyla belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “First Light of Dawn.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nahyla total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_pashto.name: نھيلا
